svg.text: Universal Agent Runtime — Prompt Processing Flow
api_chat_completion → RunManager → Orchestrator → LLM Driver → Response Stream
extract_input_message(&req) — parse user text from messages[] or message field
Creates new UUID if none provided
ProviderRegistry → default_model → global config fallback → chat-capable filter
server.rs:3321 — Resolves provider_id + model_id for this request
Uses default_agent() from defaults.rs — overrides provider/model fields
Cedar governance engine resolves per-agent or global policy
resolve_effective_caching — session → user → agent → global precedence
Searches by user_id, agent_id, session_id scope → returns [MEMORY CONTEXT] block
build_multipart_content — merge attachments (docs, images) into input
base system prompt + RAG context blocks + matched skill prompt_overlays + memory context
Falls back to global self.llm_config if agent policy can't resolve
messages[] (system + user + tool results) + tools[] (MCP + native) + stream_options
With failover: primary fails → fallback_driver.stream() if configured
Accumulate MessageDelta (text) + ToolCallDelta (id, name, args) events
Governance engine (Cedar policies) → auto / ask / deny
If "ask": emits ToolApprovalPending event, waits for POST /api/uar/runs/{id}/tool-approval
Inject tool result as Tool message into messages[]
Emit ToolResult event to stream → increment iteration counter
Response headers: X-UAR-Session-ID, X-UAR-Run-ID, Set-Cookie: uar_session
Generate Thread Title (first message only, async background)
POST /api/generate-title — LLM call to name the conversation
Key files: server.rs (entry) → manager.rs (run lifecycle) → orchestrator.rs (tool loop) → liter_driver.rs (LLM API)
Supporting: memory/service.rs (context), skills/service.rs (matching), mcp/registry.rs (tools), governance/engine.rs (Cedar policies)
Streaming: NormalizedEvent → OpenAI SSE chunks + AG-UI events (dual-protocol output)
1. Request model field (if provided) → split provider/model
5. When base_url set: model sent WITHOUT provider prefix to API
Tool approval modes: auto / ask / deny
"ask" mode: emits pending event → waits for user POST
Resilience: per-agent timeout, retry, rate limit policies
Universal Agent Runtime v0.1.0 — Prometheus AGS — April 2026
